limitations: Real election is draft with zero ballots and no candidates. Active/closed, nonzero-turnout, populated candidate rows and zero-eligible states cannot be exercised with current data without modifying records or using fixtures. Neither was done.
Browser viewport emulation is not physical-device or screen-reader testing.
